test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: P, Q, R, S and T are sitting on a bench. Q is sitting next to T. S is not sitting with P, who is at the right end of the bench. R is at the second position from the left. T sits second to the right of S. In which position is T sitting?
solution:
Five person: P, Q, R, S and T sitting on a bench.

1) S is not sitting with P, who is at the right end of the bench.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7e98d56b2492edec553aa499b34a537cfa3acafe1a8d86613dbb6c0b1636b0b.png] 

2) R is at the second position from the left.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8084b149c60d273fd1f63e8ceb6c07f59dd0c4dd06cf0c9cfe380c719492ede0.png] 

3) T sits second to the right of S.

4) Q is sitting next to T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/232c855c8b0219a1aa3e3c13c3a2762f2a180f166270552774812f153e9db1d8.png] 

Clearly, T is sitting between R and Q.

Hence, the correct answer is "Between R and Q".
